response.sql: WITH overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(modindex) as baseline FROM signals WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL), grouped_stats AS (SELECT COALESCE(rfistat, 'No Status') as rfi_status, AVG(modindex) as avg_modindex FROM signals WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL GROUP BY COALESCE(rfistat, 'No Status')), filtered_groups AS (SELECT gs.rfi_status as status, gs.avg_modindex, gs.avg_modindex - oa.baseline as above_baseline FROM grouped_stats gs CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa WHERE gs.avg_modindex > oa.baseline), mean_of_kept AS (SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) as mean_kept FROM filtered_groups) SELECT fg.status, fg.avg_modindex, fg.above_baseline, fg.avg_modindex - mk.mean_kept as diff_from_mean_kept FROM filtered_groups fg CROSS JOIN mean_of_kept mk ORDER BY fg.avg_modindex DESC
